label: Linux software/vcan diagnostic; not physical CAN FD or RT qualification
note: Under an idle box the same tuned configuration passed four consecutive acceptance runs; the store was archived after this failure and the acceptance batch was repeated on a fresh store.
root_cause: The first scenario heartbeat was sent 261 ms after the gateway's START reply because the executor persisted HIL_START_APPLIED evidence through the run store (full-store rewrite + fsync). The frozen scenario boundary is model step 250, so the first heartbeat already observed a step beyond 250 and the executor raised TIMEOUT with no ID10 TX. The 1275-test full regression suite was running concurrently and the run store held about 300 remembered requests.
